messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1 prototyping note: trying a compact card variant that keeps burst controls discoverable without extra height. Key asks: inline burst affordance, hybrid min/max input, SLO preset chips, and minimal a11y tweaks. Prototype: https://intranet.redwood/protos/autoscale-compact-card :mag:

Jun: Love compact aim. For min/max: show a small stepper by default and allow alt+click to edit exact number inline. Keeps the card tidy and supports precision.

Eli: Agree. Also suggest a single-line "target" display (current effective replica target) that expands to show min/max on click or Enter. Must have aria-expanded and announce values when opened.

Priya: Burst idea: badge next to pool name that reads "Temporary burst: ON" (or OFF). Click opens a tiny popover with amount + policy. Badge keeps card height stable and surfaces details on demand.

Sam: Accessibility notes: badge needs aria-pressed and a visible focus ring. Popover should be reachable by keyboard and tooltips must show on focus. Use `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"false\"` for the popover.

Maya: Cost preview: async call. Debounce slider/inputs to 350ms, cancel inflight requests, and show a subtle spinner in the cost chip. Use `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` so screen readers hear updates.

Jun: SLO presets: three chips (Low-latency, Balanced, Cost-saving). When a preset applies guardrails that change other controls, show a concise toast: "Cost-saving applied: burst disabled, max lowered to 50. Undo". Toast must be keyboard-focusable.

Eli: UX microcopy: prefer "Temporary burst capacity" over just "Burst". Helper text: "Enables short-term extra capacity; billed at burst rate." Keep helper visible to assistive tech even when visually collapsed.

Priya: I'll add the compact stepper + alt-edit mock, badge variant, and preset chips to Figma today. Will include all focus states and aria labels.

Sam: I'll validate tab order and announcements with NVDA/VoiceOver once frames land. If cost-announcer uses polite live region it's quieter. I can test the toast undo focus behavior too.

Maya: Perfect. If no objections I'll merge the card PR tomorrow after the Figma updates. Ping me when frames are up. :rocket:
